parameters.name: CheckPoint
parameters.description:
The offset of the Incremental Write module. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. 

> The default value is the offset that is automatically saved by DTS when the task is paused.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the reverse task that was created by calling the CreateReverseDtsJob operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts start-reverse-writer --dts-job-id n99m9jx822k0000 --check-point 1695613785 --resource-group-id '资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。' --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts StartReverseWriter --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId n99m9jx822k0000 --ResourceGroupId '资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。' --CheckPoint 1695613785
